description: This file implements a Windows-specific socket waiter mechanism, managing socket events, waiting for network events, and handling wakeup signals. It includes functions for translating network events, managing socket interest interests, and coordinating socket waiters with internal classes and methods.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate
classes.description: Implements a Windows-specific socket waiter, managing socket events, waiting for network events, and handling wakeup signals.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate::Waitee
classes.description: Represents a socket interest registration with associated callback and context.

classes.name: SbSocketWaiterPrivate::WaiteeRegistry
classes.description: Manages registration and lookup of socket waitees, including adding, removing, and retrieving waitees by index.

methods.name: TranslateNetworkBitIntoInterests
methods.description: Translates network event bits into interest flags for socket readiness.

methods.name: DiscoverNetworkEventInterests
methods.description: Enumerates network events for a socket and returns interest flags based on the events.

methods.name: EraseIndexFromVector
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified index from a vector by swapping with the last element.

methods.name: CombineInterests
methods.description: Combines two interest flags into a single interest flag using bitwise OR.
